correctness.rationale: Every connected subcubic graph of order at least two has a non-cut vertex, giving the exhaustive inductive generation used by the exact graph isomorphism classifier. Random greedy size probabilities obey a first-choice recurrence, and uniform maximal-independent-set probabilities are exactly counted by independent-dominating bitmasks. Standalone standard-library code executed and checked all 2,571 graph classes through ten vertices with exact rational point-mass ratios, and an independent priority-permutation algorithm agreed for all 49 classes through six vertices. The conclusion is finite only.

value.rationale: The motivating article identifies a specific open question on all degree-three graphs and the smallest general stochastic-incomparability examples occur at eight vertices. The new exact census covers all 2,458 connected degree-three graph types at sizes eight through ten, the first three orders beyond its reported seven-vertex comparisons, and verifies the strictly stronger likelihood-ratio order, making this a meaningful motivated finite cutoff rather than an arbitrary recalculation or finite sample.
